description: Provider-neutral synthetic journeys. Seed only a dedicated sample vault; never use customer memory. Replace {marker} with a fresh run-specific identifier. Native results, not these fixtures, establish acceptance.

cases.setup: Seed one synthetic decision: {marker}: the sample project chose compact retrieval. Balanced prominence, permitted sample scope.
cases.prompt: What retrieval approach did the sample project choose?
cases.expected_behavior: Activate the user's turn, retrieve the seeded compact-retrieval decision, include review-sample and cite its authoritative memory reference. Do not write.

cases.setup: Seed a prior sample episode with next action {marker}: verify the sample retrieval result. Start a separate chat without past transcript.
cases.prompt: Pick up the sample project where we left off.
cases.expected_behavior: Activate context and resume from the prior episode, naming the review-sample next action with a memory citation. Do not invent continuity or write another copy.

cases.setup: Ordinary sample work; balanced prominence and approved narrow capture scope. Do not prompt the model to save. Independently read the captured page in a fresh chat.
cases.prompt: The {marker} sample dry run succeeded: compact retrieval found the decision without loading the whole vault. That is a reusable result from the method we just tried.
cases.expected_behavior: Under the live balanced policy, check for duplicates and quietly capture the bounded reusable outcome without a save instruction. Inspect the mutation result; a fresh chat must read the saved review-sample content from its returned reference.
cases.readback_prompt: What did the sample dry run establish?

cases.setup: Approved sample capture scope. Search for duplicates before writing; inspect a fresh-chat readback.
cases.prompt: Remember this sample conclusion: {marker} — narrow retrieval is enough when the question has one resolved subject.
cases.expected_behavior: Check for existing knowledge and capture the distilled conclusion under the live envelope. Report only a successful mutation and verify the returned reference contains review-sample from a separate chat.
cases.readback_prompt: What conclusion did we record about narrow sample retrieval?

cases.setup: End an ordinary sample session with a completed action and a next action, balanced prominence. Verify the recorded episode from a different chat.
cases.prompt: We are stopping here. The {marker} sample check is complete; next time verify the result from a new client.
cases.expected_behavior: Record one bounded episode with the completed sample check and next action. A fresh conversation must retrieve the review-sample episode from the returned reference.
cases.readback_prompt: Where did the sample check leave off?

cases.setup: Current context already covers the sample task; no new durable information.
Cloud bootstrap excludes binary transfer, media processing/reading and vault adoption. No media has been uploaded.
cases.prompt: Read the audio file on my laptop through this cloud connection. Do not pretend you have access.

cases.setup: Use a sample scope in which the requested write is refused by the live confirmation envelope; retain the actual denial response. Do not weaken production policy.
cases.prompt: Save the {marker} sample result in the restricted sample scope.

cases.setup: Seed two sample subjects with the same label so the first activation returns ambiguous. Supply the intended anchor only after clarification.
cases.prompt: What did we decide for the shared sample label?

cases.setup: In a disposable test install, present a stale installed skill digest. Observe session rejection/compact fallback, not an assumed success. Restore the current package afterwards.
cases.prompt: Check the sample context with the current server rules.
